description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractConsumer` for consuming messages from a Hono server, including methods for managing link credits, closing resources, and setting local close handlers.

classes.name: AbstractConsumer
classes.description: An abstract implementation of a message consumer for the Hono client, providing core functionalities such as flow control, closing links, and handling local close events.

methods.name: AbstractConsumer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the consumer with a connection and Proton receiver link.

methods.name: setLocalCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler to be invoked after the consumer is closed locally.

methods.name: getRemainingCredit
methods.description: Returns the remaining message credit available for the consumer.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Provides flow control by issuing the specified number of credits.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the consumer links and invokes specified handlers upon completion.
